Source: https://github.com/markziemann/bioinformatics_intro_workshop

## Libs

```{r,libs}

library(GSVA)
library(edgeR)
library(msigdbr)

```

## Load gene expression data

From GEO https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/query/acc.cgi?acc=GSE158420
GSE158420_counts.txt.gz

Data was cleaned according to another script `GSE158420_geneexpression_prep.Rmd`

```{r,loaddat}

x <- readRDS("GSE158420_counts_fixed.rds")

x[1:6,1:5]

```

## 1. Filter low-expression genes and normalise

```{r,filt_normalise}

y <- DGEList(counts = x)
keep <- filterByExpr(y)
y <- y[keep, , keep.lib.sizes = FALSE]
y <- calcNormFactors(y)
y[1:6,1:5]

```

## 2. Calculate log-CPM expression values

```{r,logCPM}

expr <- cpm(y, log = TRUE, prior.count = 2)
expr[1:6,1:4]

## 3. Obtain reactome gene sets

```{r,reactome}

gs <- gmt_import("ReactomePathways_2026-10-23.gmt")

```

## 4. Run GSVA

```{r,run_gsva}

param <- gsvaParam(
    expr = expr,
    geneSets = gs,
    kcdf = "Gaussian",
    minSize = 10,
    maxSize = 500
)

scores <- gsva(param)

```

# 5. Inspect results
dim(scores)          # pathways x samples
scores[1:5, 1:5]    # example enrichment scores

# 6. Save scores
write.csv(scores, "GSVA_scores.csv")
